content:
Apple TV just launched a new $5.99/month (50% off) promo deal that lets Amazon Prime members subscribe at a steep discount for up to two months. Here are the details.

Apple TV available at $5.99/month for Amazon Prime members through June 26

Apple TV has its best summer lineup ever coming, anchored by highly anticipated returning series like Ted Lasso and Silo.

Ahead of those big premieres, Apple is ramping up partnerships with third parties to expand the reach of the service.

The latest example is a new deal exclusively for Amazon Prime members.

Prime members can get Apple TV for only $5.99/month for up to two months.

You can get the deal here through Prime Video.

This offer is only available through June 26, so you’ll need to sign up before then.

Prime Video is a popular hub for not only Amazon content, but also third-party streaming services. That’s because you can subscribe to Apple TV, Peacock, HBO Max, and more directly through Prime.

If you subscribe through Prime at the discounted rate, you’ll be able to watch Apple TV right from the same Prime Video app where Amazon’s own content lives.

For more details and to subscribe, visit this page while logged into your Amazon account.

If you wish to subscribe directly through Apple, you’ll have to pay the normal price. Apple TV is normally $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
